#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +e
run="/home/trading/jean-flow-exec/staging_runs/20260827T195636Z_tokyo_n2_gate4_mejoras_30m"
py="/home/trading/jean-flow-v2.4.1/555/binance_phase1_collector/.venv/bin/python"
export PYTHONPATH="$run/overlay/src"
mkdir -p "$run/audit"
spot=("$run"/capture/spot/events-*.csv)
usdm=("$run"/capture/usdm_futures/events-*.csv)
"$py" -m binance_collector.audit journal "${spot[@]}" >"$run/audit/journal_spot.json" 2>"$run/audit/journal_spot.stderr"
rc_spot=$?
echo "journal_spot=$rc_spot"
"$py" -m binance_collector.audit journal "${usdm[@]}" >"$run/audit/journal_usdm.json" 2>"$run/audit/journal_usdm.stderr"
rc_usdm=$?
echo "journal_usdm=$rc_usdm"
"$py" -m binance_collector.audit identity "${spot[@]}" "${usdm[@]}" >"$run/audit/identity.json" 2>"$run/audit/identity.stderr"
rc_identity=$?
echo "identity=$rc_identity"
"$py" -m binance_collector.audit metrics --event-loop-p99-ms 20 "$run/capture/jean_flow_metrics.jsonl" >"$run/audit/metrics.json" 2>"$run/audit/metrics.stderr"
rc_metrics=$?
echo "metrics=$rc_metrics"
printf '{"journal_spot":%d,"journal_usdm":%d,"identity":%d,"metrics":%d}
' "$rc_spot" "$rc_usdm" "$rc_identity" "$rc_metrics" >"$run/audit/return_codes.json"
echo AUDITS_FINISHED
if (( rc_spot == 0 && rc_usdm == 0 && rc_identity == 0 && rc_metrics == 0 )); then
  exit 0
fi
exit 1
